paper_title: Token-Level Uncertainty Estimation for Large Language Model Reasoning
caption: Left: Uncertainty estimation with different perturbation strength _q. Right: Influence of perturbation strength on uncertainty-based AUROC scores.
model_annotation: This line plot illustrates how three different uncertainty estimation methods—AU (red line with circle markers), TU (blue line with circle markers), and EU (green line with circle markers)—vary with increasing perturbation strength σ_q, which is plotted on the x-axis ranging from 0.02 to 0.5 in linear scale. The y-axis represents the uncertainty estimation values, ranging from 0.000 to 0.200 in linear scale. The AU method starts at approximately 0.122 and remains nearly flat until σ_q reaches 0.2, after which it rises to approximately 0.153 at σ_q = 0.5. The TU method begins at approximately 0.122 and remains nearly flat until σ_q = 0.2, after which it increases to approximately 0.180 at σ_q = 0.5. The EU method remains nearly flat at 0.000 until σ_q reaches 0.2, after which it increases to approximately 0.050 at σ_q = 0.5.
